description.narrative: The project "Toutes unies, nos voix comptent" is implemented by the Association Culture - Arts Rumbu, with the main objective of promoting the civic and political participation of female students with disabilities in universities in Niamey and Maradi, through theatre. The aim is to - To create a framework of expression for female students with disabilities at the level of the universities of Niamey and Maradi to speak in public places (such as Place AB) for their civic, students union and political inclusion. - To equip women students with disabilities to influence the decision making and texts of the Union des Etudiants Nigériens à l'Université de Niamey et Maradi (UENUN ET UNUM). Activities will include - 2 training bootcamps on public speaking andpolitical leadership for women with 30 students with disabilities, 15 of whom will be at the University of Niamey and 15 at the University of Maradi. - 2 conferences for young women students with disabilities led by role models (including people with disabilities) who will share their experiences and life paths. - 2 forum theatre workshops, respectively at the University of Niamey and Maradi, in collaboration with the Cultural Affairs Commission of the said universities, mobilizing the rightsholders themselves to become fully involved as actors. At the end of this project, we hope to have a maximum number of female students with disabilities capable of publicly asserting themselves through speech.

participating-org.narrative:
Created in 2018, the association ACA RUMBU was born from the will of students in Arts <(>&<)> Culture department of the University of Niamey (Niger) to contribute to the cultural influence within the Nigerienne communities.
Up to date, ACA RUMBU is mainly :
- Five editions of the Warriors Battle urban dance festival,
- Cultural mediation activities with young prisoners (minors)
- Capacitybuilding activities or initiation to artistic practices in universities and with vulnerable youth
The NOW-Nous award is the first project of this type for the organisation and we hope the implementation will lead to great impact and attract bigger grants for thereinforcment of the organisation.
